steps.say: Your body has many parts. Each part helps you do something.

figure.alt: A hand, an eye, an ear and a nose.

steps.say: Your head has your eyes, ears, nose and mouth.
Your arm bends at the elbow. Your hands hold things.
Your leg bends at the knee. Your feet help you walk.
Some parts are inside you. Your heart beats in your chest.

options.why: The elbow is on your arm.
The wrist is between your hand and your arm.

hints: Sit down and look at your legs.
Find the place where your leg folds.
Put your hand on the middle of your leg.
check.explanation: Your leg bends at the knee. Your arm bends at the elbow.

check.prompt: Which body part helps you hold a cup?

options.why: Your knee helps your leg bend.

hints: Think about drinking from a cup.
Pretend to hold a cup now.
check.explanation: We hold a cup with our hand. Our fingers wrap around it.
